## 1. A GRAMÁTICA — schema de "cartão" de motion graphics

### 1.1 Campos (aditivos ao beat existente, todos OPCIONAIS, retrocompatíveis)

O beat continua `{t_start, t_end, phrase, emphasis?}`. O template novo consome MAIS 3 campos opcionais; ausentes ⇒ derivados. Os 7 templates de legenda ignoram (só leem os 4 originais) ⇒ zero regressão.

| Campo | Tipo | MVP (Fatia 1) | Origem no superset |
|---|---|---|---|
| `role` | `'hero' \| 'context'` | DERIVADO de `emphasis` + posição no `phrase` (regra 1.3) | Autorado pelo detector (índice da cue) |
| `zone` | enum de zona (1.4) | IGNORADO — template fixa `lower-left` | Sonda de saliência B (Fatia 2), por clip |
| `group` | `number` | IGNORADO — 1 beat = 1 cartão | Detector agrupa context-beat + hero-beat (mesmo `group` = 1 cartão simultâneo) |

**Regra de seam (arquitetura, verificada por elas):** no MVP nada disso viaja pelo `sanitizeBeats:60` porque é derivado DENTRO do `applyProps` do template. Quando `role`/`zone`/`group` forem autorados a montante, `sanitizeBeats:52-63` (whitelist) e `detect-viral-moments:235` (build) crescem em lock-step — Fatia 2/3.

### 1.2 O cartão (o que a tela mostra por beat)

Um cartão = no máx. **1 linha de CONTEXTO (pequena, 1–3 palavras)** + **1 HERO (grande, 1 palavra, máx. 2)**, empilhados, flush-left, ancorados numa zona do vazio.

> **Mudança de contrato explícita (dirigida pelo Sovereign):** motion-editorial ABANDONA o contrato de transcrição-completa das legendas. É um **pôster das palavras-chave**, não a frase inteira — "o resto NÃO entra" é *feature* (esparsidade), não a "mutilação silenciosa" que a doutrina do auto-fit combate. As legendas karaoke (que preservam a frase inteira com reticências) **coexistem** por-clip via `caption_style` — o Sovereign adiciona um estilo, não remove nenhum.

### 1.3 Mapeamento `emphasis` → papel/intensidade + split contexto/hero (DETERMINÍSTICO, verbatim — Lei 1)

O `emphasis` do detector é por-BEAT (não por-palavra). Portanto:

**(a) Intensidade do cartão vem do `emphasis`:**

| `emphasis` | Cartão | Contexto | Hero | Acento |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hook` | **HERO card (clímax)** | branco 52px/500 | 184px/880 **CIANO `#22D3EE`** | + 1 gráfico (régua OU colchetes) |
| `punch` | **HERO card** | branco 52px/500 | 184px/880 **branco** | nenhum |
| `normal` | **QUIET line** | (suprimido) | 96px/700 branco, 1 palavra | nenhum |

Isso dá ritmo keynote: beats brancos quietos pontuados por heros grandes, com **UM só** clímax ciano nos `hook`.

**(b) Qual palavra é o hero dentro do beat (split posicional verbatim):**
```
tokens   = phrase.split(/\s+/)                    // verbatim, nada inventado
STOP_PTBR = {a,o,os,as,um,uma,de,do,da,dos,das,e,ou,que,é,em,no,na,por,com,se,ao,à}
heroIdx  = último i com tokens[i].toLowerCase() ∉ STOP_PTBR   // anda de trás p/ frente
           (se todos forem stopword → heroIdx = último token)
hero     = tokens[heroIdx]                        // UPPERCASE só no display
context  = tokens[max(0,heroIdx-3) .. heroIdx-1]  // até 3 palavras; se heroIdx==0 → sem contexto
```
`normal` ⇒ só o hero (contexto suprimido). **Honestidade (é heurística):** "última palavra de conteúdo = hero" acerta o payload em punchlines pt-BR ("…é a **NOTÍCIA**", "…constrói a **DECISÃO**") mas erra em frases cujo payload não é terminal. O **superset** (Fatia 2/3) faz o detector autorar o índice do hero rotulando cues EXISTENTES — nunca inventa texto (Lei 1). A `zone` **jamais** é derivada do SRT: é escolha visual (preset ou sonda), nunca uma alegação de "evita o sujeito" que o pipeline não rastreia.

### 1.4 Enum de zona + âncoras CSS (o template honra quando `zone` chega; MVP fixa `lower-left`)

| `zone` | `align-items` | `justify-content` | `text-align` | Grade 3×3 da sonda B → zona |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lower-left` *(default MVP)* | flex-start | flex-end | left | BL |
| `lower-right` | flex-end | flex-end | right | BR |
| `upper-left` | flex-start | flex-start | left | TL |
| `upper-right` | flex-end | flex-start | right | TR |
| `mid-left` | flex-start | center | left | ML |
| `mid-right` | flex-end | center | right | MR |
| `center-stack` *(fallback)* | center | center | center | TM/MM/BM |

### 1.5 Preset cinético (UMA gramática, repetida — consistência > variedade)

`rise-soft` (default e único no MVP): por palavra, `translateY(14px→0)` + `opacity(0→1 linear)` + (só no hero) `blur(6px→0)`. Entrada = *emphasized decelerate* ~380ms; saída = *emphasized accelerate* ~200ms; hold estável no meio. Stagger keynote: **contexto entra primeiro; hero aterrissa +200ms depois** (nunca simultâneo). Sem bounce/overshoot, sem scale-pop 0.6→1.

Presets alternativos (documentados, NÃO no MVP): `weight-in` (hero sobe de 400→880 ao aterrissar, reusa a técnica do `caption-weight-shift`), `mask-up` (clip-path wipe de baixo, "keynote"). Escolher UM e repetir no vídeo inteiro.

### 1.6 Como o acento de cor entra

Mono branco `#FFFFFF` para contexto E hero. O acento ÚNICO **ciano `#22D3EE`** (já no código) é EXCLUSIVO do hero de `hook` (o clímax) — assim o acento *significa* algo. O ouro `#F5C542` é **removido**. Gráfico permitido: UM elemento discreto na cor do acento, SÓ no hero de `hook` — **ou** uma régua fina sob o hero, **ou** um par de colchetes `[ ]` enquadrando (nunca os dois). Espessura 4–8px, ~60–70% da largura do hero, entra/sai junto com o hero na MESMA decelerate.

> 150	export async function encodeImageSequence(spec: ImageSequenceSpec, outPath: string): Promise<RenderResult> {
> 151	  const started = Date.now();
> 152	  const images = (spec.images ?? []).map((p) => resolve(p));

> 156	  const secPer = spec.seconds_per_image ?? 2.5;
> 157	  const W = spec.width ?? 1080;
> 158	  const H = spec.height ?? 1920;
> 159	
> 160	  // FFmpeg concat demuxer: hold each image for `secPer`s. The demuxer drops the final entry's duration,
> 161	  // so the last file is repeated once (documented ffmpeg quirk) to honor its hold time.
> 162	  const listDir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'hf-seq-'));
> 163	  const esc = (p: string) => p.replace(/'/g, "'\\''");
> 164	  const lines: string[] = [];
> 165	  for (const p of images) { lines.push(`file '${esc(p)}'`); lines.push(`duration ${secPer}`); }
> 166	  lines.push(`file '${esc(images[images.length - 1])}'`);
> 167	  const listPath = join(listDir, 'frames.txt');
> 168	  writeFileSync(listPath, lines.join('\n') + '\n');
> 169	
> 170	  try {
> 171	    await runFfmpeg([
> 172	      '-y',
> 173	      '-f', 'concat', '-safe', '0', '-i', listPath,
> 174	      // scale to fit, pad to the exact 9:16 canvas (letterbox, no crop), normalize SAR, fix fps
> 175	      '-vf', `scale=${W}:${H}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=${W}:${H}:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:color=black,setsar=1,fps=${fps}`,
> 176	      '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20',
> 177	      '-pix_fmt', 'yuv420p', '-r', String(fps),
> 178	      '-movflags', '+faststart', '-fflags', '+bitexact', '-flags:v', '+bitexact', '-map_metadata', '-1',
> 179	      outPath,
> 180	    ]);
> 181	  } finally {
> 182	    rmSync(listDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
> 183	  }
> 184	  if (!existsSync(outPath) || statSync(outPath).size < 1024) throw new Error('encodeImageSequence: output missing or too small');
> 185	  const probed = await ffprobeVideo(outPath);
> 186	  return {
> 187	    outPath,
> 188	    bytes: statSync(outPath).size,
> 189	    width: probed.width,
> 190	    height: probed.height,
> 191	    frames: probed.frames,
> 192	    fps: probed.fps,
> 193	    durationMs: Date.now() - started,
> 194	  };
> 195	}

> 197	// ── Free image-to-video (Ken Burns) — the Sovereign's "animar as imagens geradas 5-8s cada" ──────────────────
> 198	// Deterministic pan/zoom over a single still → an animated 9:16 clip via FFmpeg zoompan. ZERO paid API — the free
> 199	// substitute for neural i2v (Higgsfield DoP/Kling/Seedance), which stay as the paid opt-in. Upscale 2× first so
> 200	// zoompan's integer stepping stays smooth (documented anti-jitter trick).
> 201	export interface KenBurnsSpec {
> 202	  image: string;               // absolute path to the still to animate
> 203	  duration_s?: number;         // default 6 (the 5-8s range)
> 204	  fps?: number;                // default 30
> 205	  width?: number;              // 1080
> 206	  height?: number;             // 1920 → 9:16
> 207	  zoom?: 'in' | 'out';         // default 'in'
> 208	  max_zoom?: number;           // default 1.25
> 209	}
> 210	
> 211	export async function encodeKenBurns(spec: KenBurnsSpec, outPath: string): Promise<RenderResult> {
> 212	  const started = Date.now();
> 213	  const img = resolve(spec.image);
> 214	  if (!existsSync(img)) throw new Error(`encodeKenBurns: missing image ${img}`);
> 215	  const fps = spec.fps ?? 30;
> 216	  const dur = spec.duration_s ?? 6;
> 217	  const W = spec.width ?? 1080;
> 218	  const H = spec.height ?? 1920;
> 219	  const totalFrames = Math.round(dur * fps);
> 220	  const maxZoom = spec.max_zoom ?? 1.25;
> 221	  const step = (maxZoom - 1) / totalFrames;
> 222	  // Ramp 1 → maxZoom (in) or maxZoom → 1 (out) across the clip; `on` = output frame index (deterministic).
> 223	  const zExpr = (spec.zoom ?? 'in') === 'in'
> 224	    ? `min(zoom+${step.toFixed(6)},${maxZoom})`
> 225	    : `max(${maxZoom.toFixed(6)}-on*${step.toFixed(6)},1.0)`;
> 226	  const vf =
> 227	    `scale=${W * 2}:${H * 2},` +
> 228	    `zoompan=z='${zExpr}':d=${totalFrames}:x='iw/2-(iw/zoom/2)':y='ih/2-(ih/zoom/2)':s=${W}x${H}:fps=${fps},` +
> 229	    `setsar=1`;
> 230	  await runFfmpeg([
> 231	    '-y',
> 232	    '-loop', '1', '-i', img,
> 233	    '-t', String(dur),
> 234	    '-vf', vf,
> 235	    '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20',
> 236	    '-pix_fmt', 'yuv420p', '-r', String(fps),
> 237	    '-movflags', '+faststart', '-map_metadata', '-1',
> 238	    outPath,
> 239	  ]);
> 240	  if (!existsSync(outPath) || statSync(outPath).size < 1024) throw new Error('encodeKenBurns: output missing or too small');
> 241	  const probed = await ffprobeVideo(outPath);
> 242	  return {
> 243	    outPath,
> 244	    bytes: statSync(outPath).size,
> 245	    width: probed.width,
> 246	    height: probed.height,
> 247	    frames: probed.frames,
> 248	    fps: probed.fps,
> 249	    durationMs: Date.now() - started,
> 250	  };
> 251	}

> 253	// ── Studio-project render (FR-VS-047 → FR-VS-050 native, SDD §VS-UI-C) ───────────────────────────────────────
> 254	// Default engine = NATIVE on @hyperframes/core (Apache-2.0, LICENSE shipped in the npm tarball — attribution:
> 255	// © HeyGen, https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes). The CLI wrap is kept as emergency rollback only
> 256	// (STUDIO_RENDER_ENGINE=cli) — its npm artifact ships no license grant (OTD-VS-020).
> 257	// Single-tenant Usuário Zero root (OTD-VS-019 multi-tenant deferred). Overridable by env for portability/tests.
> 258	const STUDIO_PROJECTS_ROOT = process.env.STUDIO_PROJECTS_ROOT ?? '/home/ubuntu/.mcorch/video-studio/projects';
> 259	const HF_CLI = process.env.HYPERFRAMES_CLI ?? '/home/ubuntu/.bun/install/global/node_modules/hyperframes/dist/cli.js';
> 260	const HF_NODE = process.env.HYPERFRAMES_NODE ?? '/home/ubuntu/.local/bin/node'; // node v22 (hyperframes needs >=22)
> 261	// Preset → output dimensions (mirrors the reference CLI's CANVAS_DIMENSIONS).
> 262	const RESOLUTION_DIMENSIONS: Record<string, { width: number; height: number }> = {
> 263	  portrait: { width: 1080, height: 1920 },
> 264	  landscape: { width: 1920, height: 1080 },
> 265	  square: { width: 1080, height: 1080 },
> 266	  'portrait-4k': { width: 2160, height: 3840 },
> 267	  'landscape-4k': { width: 3840, height: 2160 },
> 268	  'square-4k': { width: 2160, height: 2160 },
> 269	};
> 270	const VALID_RESOLUTIONS = new Set(Object.keys(RESOLUTION_DIMENSIONS));
> 271	
> 272	/** ffprobe a video → real dimensions/frames/fps (the renderer derives them from the composition + preset). */
> 273	function ffprobeVideo(path: string): Promise<{ width: number; height: number; frames: number; fps: number }> {
> 274	  return new Promise((res, rej) => {
> 275	    const p = spawn('ffprobe', ['-v', 'error', '-select_streams', 'v:0',
> 276	      '-show_entries', 'stream=width,height,nb_frames,r_frame_rate,duration', '-of', 'json', path],
> 277	      { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'ignore'] });
> 278	    let out = '';
> 279	    p.stdout.on('data', (d) => { out += d.toString(); });
> 280	    p.on('error', rej);
> 281	    p.on('close', (code) => {
> 282	      if (code !== 0) return rej(new Error(`ffprobe exit ${code}`));
> 283	      try {
> 284	        const s = (JSON.parse(out).streams ?? [])[0] ?? {};
> 285	        const [rn, rd] = String(s.r_frame_rate ?? '30/1').split('/').map(Number);
> 286	        const fps = rd ? rn / rd : (rn || 30);
> 287	        const frames = Number(s.nb_frames) || Math.round((Number(s.duration) || 0) * fps);
> 288	        res({ width: Number(s.width) || 0, height: Number(s.height) || 0, frames, fps });
> 289	      } catch (e) { rej(e); }
> 290	    });
> 291	  });
> 292	}

> 294	/**
> 295	 * Render a composition spec to a deterministic 9:16 MP4 at `outPath`.
> 296	 * Throws on any failure (the worker translates that to finalize_video_render(failed, refund)).
> 297	 */
> 298	export async function renderComposition(spec: RenderSpec, outPath: string): Promise<RenderResult> {
> 299	  const t0 = Date.now();
> 300	  const template = spec.template && VALID_TEMPLATES.has(spec.template) ? spec.template : 'viral-short-9x16';
> 301	  const fps = Math.max(1, Math.min(60, spec.fps ?? 30));
> 302	  const durationS = Math.max(1, Math.min(60, spec.duration_s ?? 6));
> 303	  const width = spec.width ?? 1080;
> 304	  const height = spec.height ?? 1920;
> 305	  const totalFrames = Math.round(durationS * fps);
> 306	
> 307	  const templatePath = resolve(__dirname, 'templates', `${template}.html`);
> 308	  if (!existsSync(templatePath)) throw new Error(`template_not_found: ${template}`);
> 309	
> 310	  const frameDir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'hf-frames-'));
> 311	  const browser = await chromium.launch({
> 312	    headless: true,
> 313	    // Single-tenant Usuário Zero (OTD-VA-011). Multi-tenant hardening (seccomp/egress-only container) = User 1.
> 314	    args: ['--no-sandbox', '--disable-dev-shm-usage', '--force-color-profile=srgb', '--disable-lcd-text'],
> 315	  });
> 316	  try {
> 317	    const page = await browser.newPage({
> 318	      viewport: { width, height },
> 319	      deviceScaleFactor: 1,
> 320	    });
> 321	    await page.goto(`file://${templatePath}`, { waitUntil: 'load' });
> 322	    await page.evaluate((props) => (window as HfWindow).applyProps(props), spec.props as Record<string, unknown>);
> 323	
> 324	    // Deterministically wait for the product image (if any) to settle — bounded, no wallclock leakage into frames.
> 325	    await page.evaluate(() => new Promise<void>((res) => {
> 326	      const img = document.getElementById('mediaImg') as HTMLImageElement | null;
> 327	      if (!img || img.style.display === 'none' || img.complete) return res();
> 328	      const done = () => res();
> 329	      img.addEventListener('load', done, { once: true });
> 330	      img.addEventListener('error', done, { once: true });
> 331	      setTimeout(done, 8000);
> 332	    }));
> 333	
> 334	    // Frame-by-frame capture (driven by index, not time → reproducible).
> 335	    for (let i = 0; i < totalFrames; i++) {
> 336	      await page.evaluate(([idx, total]) => (window as HfWindow).applyFrame(idx, total), [i, totalFrames] as [number, number]);
> 337	      await page.screenshot({
> 338	        path: join(frameDir, `f_${String(i).padStart(5, '0')}.png`),
> 339	        clip: { x: 0, y: 0, width, height },
> 340	        animations: 'disabled',
> 341	      });
> 342	    }
> 343	    await browser.close();
> 344	
> 345	    await encodePngFramesBitexact(frameDir, fps, outPath);
> 346	
> 347	    if (!existsSync(outPath)) throw new Error('render_produced_no_file');
> 348	    const bytes = statSync(outPath).size;
> 349	    if (bytes < 100 * 1024) throw new Error(`render_too_small: ${bytes} bytes (< 100KB, Lei 1 gate)`);
> 350	
> 351	    return { outPath, bytes, width, height, frames: totalFrames, fps, durationMs: Date.now() - t0 };
> 352	  } finally {
> 353	    await browser.close().catch(() => {});
> 354	    rmSync(frameDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
> 355	  }
> 356	}

> 358	export interface AlphaFramesResult {
> 359	  frameDir: string;
> 360	  framePattern: string;   // e.g. 'f_%05d.png'
> 361	  frames: number;
> 362	  fps: number;
> 363	  width: number;
> 364	  height: number;
> 365	}

> 367	/**
> 368	 * Render a composition's TEXT/GRAPHIC layer to a TRANSPARENT PNG sequence (RGBA, no background) for compositing
> 369	 * OVER real footage (video-repurpose FR-VR-011/012). Same deterministic index-driven loop as renderComposition,
> 370	 * but page.screenshot({ omitBackground: true }) → alpha preserved, and NO MP4 encode (yuv420p would drop alpha).
> 371	 * The template MUST have a transparent html/body background (e.g. 'viral-caption-overlay-9x16').
> 372	 * Injects fps + durationSec into props so time-based templates map frame index → clip seconds.
> 373	 * Returns the frame dir + %05d pattern; the CALLER overlays with FFmpeg and cleans the dir up.
> 374	 */
> 375	export async function renderAlphaFrames(spec: RenderSpec, outDir?: string): Promise<AlphaFramesResult> {
> 376	  const template = spec.template && VALID_TEMPLATES.has(spec.template) ? spec.template : 'viral-caption-overlay-9x16';
> 377	  const fps = Math.max(1, Math.min(60, spec.fps ?? 30));
> 378	  const durationS = Math.max(1, Math.min(60, spec.duration_s ?? 6));
> 379	  const width = spec.width ?? 1080;
> 380	  const height = spec.height ?? 1920;
> 381	  const totalFrames = Math.round(durationS * fps);
> 382	
> 383	  const templatePath = resolve(__dirname, 'templates', `${template}.html`);
> 384	  if (!existsSync(templatePath)) throw new Error(`template_not_found: ${template}`);
> 385	
> 386	  const frameDir = outDir ?? mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'hf-alpha-'));
> 387	  const browser = await chromium.launch({
> 388	    headless: true,
> 389	    // --allow-file-access-from-files: let the file:// template load its self-hosted @font-face (fonts/*.ttf).
> 390	    args: ['--no-sandbox', '--disable-dev-shm-usage', '--force-color-profile=srgb', '--disable-lcd-text', '--allow-file-access-from-files'],
> 391	  });
> 392	  try {
> 393	    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height }, deviceScaleFactor: 1 });
> 394	    await page.goto(`file://${templatePath}`, { waitUntil: 'load' });
> 395	    await page.evaluate(
> 396	      (props) => (window as HfWindow).applyProps(props),
> 397	      { ...spec.props, fps, durationSec: durationS } as Record<string, unknown>,
> 398	    );
> 399	
> 400	    // Wait for the self-hosted @font-face to finish loading → no fallback-font early frames (deterministic).
> 401	    await page.evaluate(() => (document as { fonts?: { ready?: Promise<unknown> } }).fonts?.ready).catch(() => {});
> 402	
> 403	    for (let i = 0; i < totalFrames; i++) {
> 404	      await page.evaluate(([idx, total]) => (window as HfWindow).applyFrame(idx, total), [i, totalFrames] as [number, number]);
> 405	      await page.screenshot({
> 406	        path: join(frameDir, `f_${String(i).padStart(5, '0')}.png`),
> 407	        clip: { x: 0, y: 0, width, height },
> 408	        omitBackground: true,           // ← RGBA, transparent bg preserved (the overlay layer)
> 409	        animations: 'disabled',
> 410	      });
> 411	    }
> 412	    await browser.close();
> 413	
> 414	    const first = join(frameDir, 'f_00000.png');
> 415	    if (!existsSync(first) || statSync(first).size < 1024) throw new Error(`alpha_frames_too_small: ${first}`);
> 416	
> 417	    return { frameDir, framePattern: 'f_%05d.png', frames: totalFrames, fps, width, height };
> 418	  } finally {
> 419	    await browser.close().catch(() => {});
> 420	  }
> 421	}

> 423	/**
> 424	 * Render a Studio-authored project — FR-VS-050 (SDD §VS-UI-C): NATIVE engine on @hyperframes/core (Apache-2.0)
> 425	 * by default; the legacy CLI wrap (FR-VS-047 §B.3) remains available as emergency rollback via
> 426	 * STUDIO_RENDER_ENGINE=cli. Throws on any failure (worker → finalize_video_render(failed, refund)).
> 427	 *
> 428	 * Security: `project_dir` MUST resolve strictly under STUDIO_PROJECTS_ROOT (no traversal / arbitrary path exec).
> 429	 * The guard runs HERE, engine-independent, before any FS/bundle/spawn work.

> 431	export async function renderStudioProject(spec: StudioProjectSpec, outPath: string): Promise<RenderResult> {
> 432	  // Path-safety: dir must be the root or strictly inside it (blocks ../ traversal + absolute escapes).
> 433	  const dir = resolve(spec.project_dir ?? '');
> 434	  const root = resolve(STUDIO_PROJECTS_ROOT);
> 435	  if (dir !== root && !dir.startsWith(root + '/')) throw new Error(`project_dir_outside_root: ${dir}`);
> 436	  if (!existsSync(join(dir, 'index.html'))) throw new Error(`studio_project_not_found: ${join(dir, 'index.html')}`);
> 437	
> 438	  const engine = process.env.STUDIO_RENDER_ENGINE ?? 'native';
> 439	  return engine === 'cli'
> 440	    ? renderStudioProjectViaCli(dir, spec, outPath)
> 441	    : renderStudioProjectNative(dir, spec, outPath);

> 444	/**
> 445	 * FR-VS-050 — native studio-project render. Algorithm (mapped empirically from the reference CLI,
> 446	 * Workflow wf_bbc8402d-096; SDD §VS-UI-C C.3):
> 447	 *   bundleToSingleHtml(dir) [runtime inline] → temp bundle INSIDE dir (file:// keeps relative refs working)
> 448	 *   → init-script window.__HF_EXPORT_RENDER_SEEK_CONFIG={fps} (runtime reads at init; fps is renderer-owned)
> 449	 *   → goto + wait (__renderReady && __player.getDuration()>0) + fonts
> 450	 *   → per frame: __player.renderSeek(i/fps) (synchronous deterministic seek, quantized floor(t*fps+1e-9)/fps
> 451	 *     runtime-side) → PNG screenshot → shared bitexact FFmpeg encode (NFR-VS-016).
> 452	 * Declared limits (§C.3): no virtual-time shim (adapter-driven compositions only — GSAP/css/waapi/anime/lottie/
> 453	 * three); embedded <video> not pre-extracted; external pinned CDN refs need network.
> 454	 */
> 455	async function renderStudioProjectNative(dir: string, spec: StudioProjectSpec, outPath: string): Promise<RenderResult> {
> 456	  const t0 = Date.now();
> 457	  const fps = Math.max(1, Math.min(60, spec.fps ?? 30));
> 458	  const resolution = spec.resolution && VALID_RESOLUTIONS.has(spec.resolution) ? spec.resolution : 'portrait';
> 459	  const { width, height } = RESOLUTION_DIMENSIONS[resolution];
> 460	
> 461	  // Apache-2.0 import-only usage (© HeyGen — LICENSE ships in node_modules/@hyperframes/core/LICENSE).
> 462	  const { bundleToSingleHtml } = await import('@hyperframes/core/compiler');
> 463	  const html: string = await bundleToSingleHtml(dir);
> 464	
> 465	  // Serve via file:// from INSIDE the project dir so relative asset refs keep resolving.
> 466	  const bundlePath = join(dir, `.hf-native-bundle-${process.pid}-${Date.now().toString(36)}.html`);
> 467	  writeFileSync(bundlePath, html, 'utf8');
> 468	
> 469	  const frameDir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'hf-native-frames-'));
> 470	  const browser = await chromium.launch({
> 471	    headless: true,
> 472	    // Same determinism flags as the template path (single-tenant Usuário Zero, OTD-VA-011).
> 473	    args: ['--no-sandbox', '--disable-dev-shm-usage', '--force-color-profile=srgb', '--disable-lcd-text'],
> 474	  });
> 475	  try {
> 476	    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height }, deviceScaleFactor: 1 });
> 477	    // fps is renderer-owned; the embedded runtime reads this at init (fallback 30). Must precede goto.
> 478	    await page.addInitScript((v) => { (window as HfWindow).__HF_EXPORT_RENDER_SEEK_CONFIG = { fps: v, fpsSource: 'mcorch-native-render' }; }, fps);
> 479	    await page.goto(`file://${bundlePath}`, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 60_000 });
> 480	
> 481	    // Readiness (mirrors the reference pollHfReady): timelines bound + deterministic adapters ready + duration real.
> 482	    await page.waitForFunction(
> 483	      () => (window as HfWindow).__renderReady === true
> 484	        && !!(window as HfWindow).__player
> 485	        && typeof (window as HfWindow).__player!.renderSeek === 'function'
> 486	        && (window as HfWindow).__player!.getDuration() > 0,
> 487	      undefined,
> 488	      { timeout: 45_000 },
> 489	    ).catch(() => { throw new Error('studio_runtime_not_ready: __renderReady/__player.getDuration()>0 not reached in 45s'); });
> 490	    await page.evaluate(() => (document as HfDocument).fonts?.ready);
> 491	
> 492	    const duration: number = await page.evaluate(() => (window as HfWindow).__player!.getDuration());
> 493	    if (!(duration > 0)) throw new Error('studio_composition_duration_zero'); // would produce a black video
> 494	    const totalFrames = Math.ceil(duration * fps);
> 495	
> 496	    for (let i = 0; i < totalFrames; i++) {
> 497	      // Synchronous deterministic seek: pauses timelines, seeks GSAP totalTime, fans out to adapters.
> 498	      await page.evaluate((t) => (window as HfWindow).__player!.renderSeek(t), i / fps);
> 499	      await page.screenshot({
> 500	        path: join(frameDir, `f_${String(i).padStart(5, '0')}.png`),
> 501	        clip: { x: 0, y: 0, width, height },
> 502	        animations: 'allow', // css adapter seeks CSS animations; 'disabled' would force them to final state
> 503	      });
> 504	    }
> 505	    await browser.close();
> 506	
> 507	    await encodePngFramesBitexact(frameDir, fps, outPath);
> 508	
> 509	    if (!existsSync(outPath)) throw new Error('studio_render_produced_no_file');
> 510	    const bytes = statSync(outPath).size;
> 511	    if (bytes < 100 * 1024) throw new Error(`studio_render_too_small: ${bytes} bytes (< 100KB, Lei 1 gate)`);
> 512	
> 513	    const probe = await ffprobeVideo(outPath);
> 514	    return { outPath, bytes, width: probe.width, height: probe.height, frames: probe.frames, fps: probe.fps, durationMs: Date.now() - t0 };
> 515	  } finally {
> 516	    await browser.close().catch(() => {});
> 517	    rmSync(frameDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
> 518	    try { unlinkSync(bundlePath); } catch { /* already gone */ }
> 519	  }
> 520	}

> 522	/**
> 523	 * Legacy FR-VS-047 CLI wrap — emergency rollback only (STUDIO_RENDER_ENGINE=cli). The npm `hyperframes` artifact
> 524	 * ships no license grant (OTD-VS-020) — delete this path after the first editor-initiated native render passes.
> 525	 * ARM64 trap: the hyperframes-bundled Chrome does not run on ARM64 → point it at Playwright's chromium.
> 526	 */
> 527	async function renderStudioProjectViaCli(dir: string, spec: StudioProjectSpec, outPath: string): Promise<RenderResult> {
> 528	  const t0 = Date.now();
> 529	  const fps = Math.max(1, Math.min(60, spec.fps ?? 30));
> 530	  const resolution = spec.resolution && VALID_RESOLUTIONS.has(spec.resolution) ? spec.resolution : 'portrait';
> 531	  if (!existsSync(HF_CLI)) throw new Error(`hyperframes_cli_not_found: ${HF_CLI}`);
> 532	
> 533	  const browserPath = chromium.executablePath();
> 534	
> 535	  await new Promise<void>((res, rej) => {
> 536	    const p = spawn(HF_NODE, [
> 537	      HF_CLI, 'render', dir,
> 538	      '--resolution', resolution, '--fps', String(fps),

> 540	    ], {
> 541	      stdio: ['ignore', 'ignore', 'pipe'],
> 542	      env: { ...process.env, HYPERFRAMES_BROWSER_PATH: browserPath, HOME: process.env.HOME ?? '/home/ubuntu' },
> 543	    });
> 544	    let err = '';
> 545	    p.stderr.on('data', (d) => { err += d.toString(); });
> 546	    p.on('error', rej);
> 547	    p.on('close', (code) => (code === 0 ? res() : rej(new Error(`hyperframes_render_exit_${code}: ${err.slice(-800)}`))));
> 548	  });
> 549	
> 550	  if (!existsSync(outPath)) throw new Error('studio_render_produced_no_file');
> 551	  const bytes = statSync(outPath).size;
> 552	  if (bytes < 100 * 1024) throw new Error(`studio_render_too_small: ${bytes} bytes (< 100KB, Lei 1 gate)`);
> 553	
> 554	  const probe = await ffprobeVideo(outPath);
> 555	  return { outPath, bytes, width: probe.width, height: probe.height, frames: probe.frames, fps: probe.fps, durationMs: Date.now() - t0 };
> 556	}

> 558	// ── CLI (material proof harness) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> 559	if (import.meta.main) {

> 565	  const out = get('out', '/tmp/hyperframes-test.mp4')!;

> 567	  // Free image-to-video: --kenburns img.png [--kbdur 6] [--zoom in|out] (deterministic pan/zoom, US$0)
> 568	  const kbArg = get('kenburns');
> 569	  // Free "frames → video" mode: --images a.png,b.png,c.png [--sec 2.5] (Sovereign vision — HyperFrames joins pre-made frames)
> 570	  const imagesArg = get('images');
> 571	  const runner = kbArg
> 572	    ? encodeKenBurns(

Looking at the animation sequence, the entrance starts with just the context text "ISSO NÃO É" appearing in the lower-left corner while the main word "SORTE" is still hidden below the mask. By the second keyframe, "SORTE" becomes visible in cyan, but the brackets haven't appeared yet—they're coming in their own staggered timing. At frame 126, the context text is fully visible and right-aligned, while the hero "DECISÃO" is mid-reveal—about 66% through the mask animation. The image captures exactly this moment: the top half of the text is clipped by the upward-sliding mask, showing the reveal effect in action. This is the premium keynote animation working perfectly.

The animation sequence is now clear: context enters first solo, then the hero rises out of its mask, followed by the full settle with weight and accent brackets. The stagger, mask reveal, and weighted entrance all combine to create a strong two-level hierarchy—the small tracked kicker and massive heavy hero read instantly with that 3.5:1 ratio that feels like a motivational keynote. The cyan accent brackets on SORTE look genuinely architectural and premium, and the mask-up reveal is the centerpiece of the whole effect.

The text stays crisp over footage thanks to stroke and shadow, Portuguese accents render cleanly, and the sparse two-to-four-word layout feels editorial rather than cluttered. But the simulated footage itself is too uniform and clean—the subject silhouette barely registers as a person, just a dark navy gradient, so I'm not really testing whether the text respects the subject's negative space the way it should in a real scenario.

The zone placement in the demo doesn't correlate with an actual visible subject either. In production, the saliency probe would pick the empty zone, but my demo just hardcodes the zones, so I can't verify the negative-space discipline holds up when there's genuine visual competition for that space.

The context kicker and bracket proportions look fine — the brackets intentionally frame the text and sit slightly outside the cap height, which works visually.

Since the overall judgment is positive, the key improvement is getting better footage with a clearly visible subject so I can honestly test whether the layout truly respects negative space.

I'll add a backlit human silhouette on the right third with rim lighting against a brighter background, then re-render and check how the hero-left card sits in that empty space beside the figure. This way I can verify the "text in void, subject on the other side" claim actually holds optically. For the directive's ideal composition, subject on the right paired with hero text lower-left works best.

## Veredito ocular honesto (o que EU VI, não "renderizou sem erro")

**Parece PROFISSIONAL — nível dos prints de referência. SIM.**

1. **Hierarquia de dois níveis lê instantaneamente.** Kicker pequeno com tracking aberto (peso 500) + HERO gigante pesado (~880). A razão 3,5:1 entrega exatamente o look "Why Not You"/keynote. Zero ambiguidade sobre qual é a palavra-chave.
2. **Revelação escalonada é PREMIUM, sem bounce cartunesco.** Provado em 3 instantes: A1 mostra só o contexto (entra primeiro); B1 pega o hero emergindo pela metade de uma máscara (mask-up "impresso na baseline" — o gesto Apple); A3/B2 mostram o assentamento com weight-in + focus-pull (blur→0). O easing decelerate (easeOutQuint) não tem overshoot.
3. **Mono + 1 acento com disciplina.** Tudo branco; ciano `#22D3EE` aparece SÓ no hero de `hook` (SORTE), com os brackets `[ ]` arquiteturais (CSS borders, não glifo) que desenham DEPOIS do hero pousar. O `punch` (DECISÃO) fica branco, sem gráfico — o acento significa algo. Ouro removido.
4. **Texto respira no espaço negativo.** No A (hero-left) a composição é canônica: sujeito escuro à direita, "[SORTE]" no vazio inferior-esquerdo — respiração real. Acentos pt-BR (ã/é/ó) renderizam limpos (paint-order:stroke fill, sem artefato de acento quebrado).
5. **Esparso (2–4 palavras/cartão)** e legível sound-off sobre footage (stroke escuro + shadow + scrim local que abraça o cartão).

**Ressalvas honestas (Lei 1):**
- **`corner-br` (B2) sobre sujeito à direita É a colisão** — o texto fica legível (branco sobre silhueta escura) mas compositoriamente pousa EM CIMA do sujeito. Isso não é defeito do template: é exatamente o caso que a **sonda de saliência (Fatia 2)** resolve escolhendo a zona vazia. Demonstra a ancoragem geométrica das 2 zonas pedidas; em produção o `lower-left` seria eleito aqui.
- O rim light da minha cena simulada virou uma faixa vertical um tanto artificial — **detalhe do footage-sim, não do template** (o template só pinta pixels RGBA sobre o footage real).

## O que a Fatia 1 REAL teria que fechar

1. **Registrar nos allowlists (seam confirmado):** adicionar o nome em `render-core.ts` `VALID_TEMPLATES` (:95-106) e em `segment-core.ts` `CAPTION_STYLES`/`CAPTION_STYLE_SET` (:60-70) — como um `caption_style` NOVO que COEXISTE com as legendas karaoke (não substitui). Sem isso o guard de path-traversal recusa o template.
2. **Superset dos campos `role`/`hero`/`context`/`zone`/`group`:** no MVP são derivados DENTRO do `applyProps` (como prototipado). Para autorá-los a montante, crescer o whitelist de `sanitizeBeats` + o build do `detect-viral-moments` em lock-step. Até lá vale a heurística "última palavra de conteúdo = hero" (STOP_PTBR) — honesta em punchline terminal, falível em payload não-terminal.
3. **Seleção de zona = sonda de saliência (Fatia 2):** o MVP fixa `lower-left`; produção precisa da grade de densidade de borda por-clip para pousar o cartão no vazio e nunca colidir com o sujeito (o caso B2).
4. **Endurecer o auto-shrink do hero:** a ladder [184→132] foi validada só nas palavras da demo. Falta o clamp/wrap de piso para hero de 2 palavras ou token único mais largo que a safe box (hoje floreia em 132px e poderia transbordar) — mesma disciplina de fallback visível dos templates irmãos.
5. **Golden-frame smoke de determinismo** (molde `smoke-reframe-image.ts`): pinar sha/pixel-diff de N frames sob o `renderAlphaFrames` real (fonts.ready) para travar NFR-VS-016 e evitar drift.
6. **Transições entre beats:** a demo tem gap de 0,30s entre A e B. Produção deve exigir gap mínimo OU cross-fade para garantir zero flash de 1 frame no rebuild do cartão.
